q: Lopa said, "I must leave now." (Change the speech)
o: Lopa said that she had to leave then.
Lopa said that she has to leave now.
Lopa said that she must leave now.
Lopa said that she had to leave now.

q: He said to me, "Can you give me some water now?"
o: He asked me whether if I could give him some water then.
He asked me whether I could give him some water then.
He asked me if I could give him some water now.
He asked me if I could give him some water.

q: She said to me, "Let us start the meeting." [Indirect]
o: She proposed to me that we should start the meeting.
She proposed to me that we start the meeting.
She proposed to that we should start the meeting.
She propose me that we should start the meeting.

q: She said, "What a marvelous performance it was!" [indirect]
o: She exclaimed with sorrow that it had been a very marvelous performance.
She exclaimed on joy what a marvelous performance it was.
She exclaimed that it was a very marvelous performance.
She said that it was a marvelous performance.

q: The waiter said, "Thank you, Sir". (Make it indirect)
o: The waiter thanked his customer.
The waiter addressed the person 'sir' and said thank you.
The waiter respectfully thanked the person spoken to.
The waiter told that thank you sir.

q: He said, “Had I been a rich man!” (Make it Indirect)
o: He wished he had been a rich man.
He wished if he had been a rich man.
He wished he were a rich man.
He said that he had been a rich man.

q: Change the narration: He asked, "Have you seen my keys?"
o: He asked if I had seen his keys.
He asked where my keys were.
He asked me to see his keys.
He asked when I had seen his keys.

q: The girl said, "What a dreadful storm it is!" (change the narration)
o: The girl exclaimed with fear that it is a very dreadful storm.
The girl exclaimed with fear that it was a very dreadful storm.
The girl exclaimed with disgust that it was a very dreadful storm.
The girl said that it was a very dreadful storm.

q: The baby says, 'I am hungry'. (Make it indirect)
o: The baby says that it is hungry.
The baby said that it is hungry.
The baby said that it was hungry
The baby says that it was hungry.
e: Reporting verb Present বা Future Tense-এ থাকলে Direct থেকে Indirect speech করার সময় reported অংশের verb-এর কাল বদলায় না; কেবল person বদলায়। এখানে says বর্তমান কাল, তাই am hungry হয় is hungry, was নয়। I-এর বদলে baby বোঝাতে it বসে। তাই The baby says that it is hungry শুদ্ধ। Said বা was বসালে কাল বদলে যায়, যা এখানে নিয়মবিরুদ্ধ। যেমন: The farmer says, 'I am busy' হয় The farmer says that he is busy।

q: Father said to me, "May you pass the examination". (Make it direct)
o: Father expressed with hope that I may pass the examination.
Father hoped that I must pass the examination.
Father prayed that I might pass the examination.
Father wished me to pass the examination.
e: Optative বাক্য, অর্থাৎ শুভকামনা বা প্রার্থনার বাক্য, indirect করতে said-এর জায়গায় wished বা prayed বসে। তারপর that বসে, subject থাকে এবং may-এর স্থানে might আসে। উদাহরণ: The teacher said, 'May you pass' হয় The teacher wished that the students might pass। তাই Father prayed that I might pass the examination শুদ্ধ। অন্য অপশনে must বা hoped...may-এর মতো অসঙ্গত রূপ আছে, আর wished me to pass-এ ভাব বদলে যায়।

q: He said to me, "Are you sleeping now?"(Make it Indirect)
o: He asked me whether I was sleeping then.
He asked me whether he was sleeping then.
He asked me whether I was sleeping now.
He asked me whether I had been sleeping now.

q: Which is the Indirect speech of the following sentence- He said, 'Let us go for a walk.'
o: He suggested that they should go for a walk.
He said that they must go for a walk.
He proposed to go for walk.
He proposed that they would go for walk.

q: 'Come in, my friend,' said I – বাক্যটির সঠিক indirect speech : [মহাহিসাব নিরীক্ষক ও নিয়ন্ত্রকের কার্যালয়ের
o: Addressing him as my friend, I told him to go in.
Addressing him as my friend, he said him to go in.
Addressing him as my friend, I have said him to go in.
Addressing him as my friend, I told him to go in.

q: Jamil said to me, “If you come now, I can solve your problem”. (Make it Indirect)
o: Jamil told me if I went then, he could solve my problem.
Jamil told me if you went then, he could solve your problem.
Jamil told me if you came now, he could solve your problem.
Jamil told me that I came now, he could solve my problem.

q: Put the following into indirect speech: "When I got home, I found I had lost my umbrella," Laila said.
o: Laila said that when she had got home she found she lost her umbrella.
Laila said that when she had got home she found that she had lost her umbrella.
Laila said that when she got home she had found that she had lost her umbrella.
Laila said that when she got home, she found she had lost her umbrella.

q: The poor man said, "How miserable my life is!" (change into indirect speech)
o: The poor man told that his life very miserable.
The poor man exclaimed with sorrow that his life was very miserable.
The poor man said his life is very miserable.
The poor man exclaimed with joy that his life was very miserable.

q: Correct narration of the sentence: He said to me, “You cannot do it.”
o: He told me that I could not do it
He told me that I could not do that
He told me that I could not have done it
None of the above
e: Said to me থেকে হয় told me, আর can/cannot বদলে could/could not হয়। কর্তা you হয় I। Pronoun it indirect-এ বদলায় না, ‘that’-এ পরিণত হয় না (এ কারণে দ্বিতীয় অপশন ভুল)। সঠিক বাক্য: He told me that I could not do it। Could not have done অতীত না-পারা বোঝায়, তাই অর্থ পাল্টে যায়।

q: Rina said to him, "Congratulations!" Choose the correct Indirect Narration:
o: Rina says him congratulations.
Rina said congratulations to him.
Rina congratulated him.
Rina congratulates him.

q: She will say, "The train arrived late. (Change into indirect speech)
o: She will say that the train arrived late.
She will say that the train had arrived late.
She will tell that the train arrived late.
She will tell that the train had arrived late.

q: The correct indirect form of We said to the chairman, "Let us drop the matter." is -
o: We proposed the chairman drop the matter.
We proposed the chairman dropped the matter.
We proposed the chairman dropping the matter.
We proposed the chairman to be dropped the matter.
